in_sanskrit.name: grīvaḥ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The part of the body that connects the head to the torso; a place where the necklace is worn; a symbol of royalty and authority

in_hindi.name: Griva
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Cows
in_hindi.long_meaning: Griva एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Griva is the name of the goddess who protects and nourishes the cows. She is often depicted with a cow or bull, symbolizing abundance and prosperity.

in_tamil.name: Griva
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Goddess of Cows
in_tamil.long_meaning: Griva ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। In Hindu mythology, Griva is the name of the goddess who protects and nourishes the cows. She is often depicted with a cow or bull, symbolizing abundance and prosperity.

in_telugu.name: Griva
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Goddess of Cows
in_telugu.long_meaning: Griva ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। In Hindu mythology, Griva is the name of the goddess who protects and nourishes the cows. She is often depicted with a cow or bull, symbolizing abundance and prosperity.

in_marathi.name: Griva
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Cows
in_marathi.long_meaning: Griva हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Griva is the name of the goddess who protects and nourishes the cows. She is often depicted with a cow or bull, symbolizing abundance and prosperity.
